raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The 2026-01-16 change (DE-398) switched silver_transactions.txn_date from the transaction date to CAST(ingest_ts AS DATE). Ingest always lands at 02:00 the next day, so every POSTED row (4699) now disagrees with the date of txn_ts, which is what DATE_CONSISTENCY flags. Restoring txn_date to CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) matches the column name and the monitor's rule, and the gold tables rebuild from silver.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
